initialDistribution.$comment: sources/design/bcknd/set_optimization_ic.f90:100-123. The `field` type is not accepted: set_optimization_ic.f90:262 aborts without a `.fNNNNN` suffix, and with one :267 passes `trim(file_name)` as the output argument of filename_chsuffix (an expression, never written back), so the suffix reaches `f%init` at :270 and neko src/io/file.f90:133 aborts with an unknown file format.

name.description: Identifier of the design checkpoint; it is not displayed and not part of any output file name. It is written to the HDF5 design checkpoint (design_hdf5_io.f90:160-164) and compared on every load (:355-358), so a resumed run aborts unless it equals the name stored in the checkpoint. Default `Brinkman Design`. At most 64 bytes (ASCII characters only) when a design checkpoint is written or read (see the rule in `optimization`).

domain.description: Region of the mesh that is optimised.

zone_name.description: Point zone; read only with `type: point_zone`.

allOf.$comment: design_brinkman.f90:302 reads zone_name only for the point_zone domain; it is required there and unread otherwise.

dealias.description: Over-integrate the forward and adjoint Brinkman source terms (and build the adjoint Gauss stack for them). The design field itself is not dealiased. Default `case.numerics.dealias`.

verbose_design.description: Write every forward cascade stage of the design. When false, only the first unmapped stage and the mapped Brinkman amplitude are written (the design is written every iteration either way, mapping_handler.f90:165-176,184-196 configure the writers; optimizer.f90:520,547 write every iteration). Default false.

verbose_sensitivity.description: Write every backward chain-rule stage of the sensitivity as well as the final sensitivity. When false, only the final sensitivity is written (the sensitivity is written every iteration either way, mapping_handler.f90:198-221 configure the writers; optimizer.f90:520,547 write every iteration). Default false.

output_format.description: Output format. Default `fld`. `bp` and `adios2` both write `.bp` and need an ADIOS2-enabled Neko.
output_format.$comment: design_brinkman.f90:284 passes the string to field_output_t%init (mapping_handler.f90:180,205,216), which builds the suffix `.<format>` (neko src/io/field_output.f90:83-86). Other file_t suffixes (csv, vtk, chkp, nmsh, stl) abort on the first write (vtk_file.f90:141, csv_file.f90:96, chkp_file.f90:293, nmsh_file.f90:93), because the design is always written (optimizer.f90:520,547); `rea` silently writes nothing (neko src/io/rea_file.f90:452-456), `re2` and `map` abort (re2_file.f90:243, map_file.f90:93), and any other value aborts at file_t init (file.f90:133).

mapping.description: Mapping cascade from the design to the Brinkman amplitude (required: without it a null pointer is dereferenced, mapping_handler.f90:644).

initial_distribution.description: Initial design field. Default: zero everywhere. With a `point_zone` domain the values outside the domain are reset to 0 by the first forward mapping.

design.$comment: Factory: sources/design/design_factory.f90:73-81. The label `simple` is a factory case, but the shipped drivers always abort on it (simple_design_t lacks init_from_json_sim, design.f90:262), so it is not accepted.
